story_type: man in fast hurricane floodwater, agent brings him back along a rope with a raft
hook: Chest deep in Harvey's floodwater, and it was moving.
narration: Harvey's floodwater was chest deep here, and it was moving fast.
A Customs and Border Protection agent had reached a man out in the current.
Now they had to get back, along a rope, with a small raft beside them.
Six inches of fast water can knock an adult down. [short pause] This was chest deep.
He held on to the man and worked them along the line.
outcome: And the CBP crew rescued him from Harvey's floodwater.
title: Chest deep in Harvey's fast floodwater
description:
During Hurricane Harvey flooding in Texas in August 2017, a U.S. Customs and Border Protection Air and Marine Operations crew rescued a man caught in fast floodwater, with an agent bringing him back through the current along a rope with a raft.

Footage: U.S. Customs and Border Protection video by Carmen Castro, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/546843/cbp-air-and-marine-swift-water-rescue
